testcase.name: an unreadable user row falls back to the static catalog and still lets the import run
initFoodIndex before phase 1 is a no-op and the publish rebuilds the index with the static catalog
user rows and the static catalog are published while the catalog import is still suspended
the importer gets the stored meta and what it reports is kept for the next start
after the importer completes the index generation advances and contains the imported rows
a failing catalog import keeps the published user rows and the measurement reminder

testcase.name: initFoodIndex does not rebuild while the catalog generation is unchanged
a refresh after a restore rebuilds the index from the restored rows
an unreadable manifest never crashes the gate and leaves the data version as the fingerprint
the expected fingerprint is the data version plus the manifest of the assets when the build has one
without a manifest the gate falls back to the data version and adopts a legacy checksum instead of importing
refreshData stales the index at once and the publish bumps the generation again
overlapping loads never run two catalog imports at the same time
a start whose stored meta is current reads the manifest and never a catalog CSV
